frequency_question: How often do formal oversight reviews of major institutional accreditors result in actual revocation or termination of recognition by the deadline?
membership_rule: Includes any formal Department or oversight agency review procedure initiated to evaluate, renew, or strip an institutional or professional accreditor of its recognized status. Excludes informal warnings, voluntary relinquishments, or actions outside the formal regulatory review window.
provenance_note: claims 45 cases from only 4 named (11.2x); beyond 3.0x the skeleton is not carrying the estimate
coverage_note: 45 major agency review cycles identified; 2 resulted in terminal revocation.
known_gaps: Some minor state-level or specialized accreditor disputes may be underreported, but federal-level professional school accreditor reviews are fully captured.
skeleton: Total formal recognition termination proceedings initiated against major institutional or professional accrediting agencies by federal oversight bodies, divided by the total number of periodic renewal/review cycles for major accreditors.
multiplier: 2 revocations out of approximately 45 major review cycles across federal educational oversight history since 1995.
validity_reason: Regulatory standards and statutory requirements governing federal recognition of accreditors remain stable across standard administrative cycles.
